title: Tell the on-call engineer which thread everyone waits for

cases.says: a thread blocked at a synchronized block is reported with the thread that holds that lock
a dump whose threads only park on a latch reports no one as blocked
a thread inside wait() is not reported as holding the monitor it waits on, though its stack lists it as locked
a thread inside wait() is not reported as blocked by whoever holds that monitor
a thread waiting for one object is charged to that object's holder, not to a thread holding another object of the same class
a thread holding nested locks is reported for every one of them

origin.section: A Thread Dump Names a Deadlock Cycle, Not a Thread Stuck Behind a Holder That Waits
